test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements : **

Some houses are flats.

Some flats are spacious.

All spacious are expensive.

**Conclusions :**

I. Some flats are expensive.

II. Some houses are spacious.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0f6f90517a463134fbb7bac942002e8299ae2aa78c491fbb2aaa5dd474d1dffc.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some flats are expensive → Follow (As some flats are spacious and all spacious are expensive. So, as whole spacious comes in expensive and has also some part common with flats therefore, it is definitely true)

II. Some houses are spacious → Does not follow (As some houses are flats and some flats are spacious. So, it is possible but not definitely true)

∴ Here, Only conclusion I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Only conclusion I follows".
